scope: Train-only source-weighted gradient pilot on the unchanged full-fit inner partition; no new Dev/Test prediction or selection

allocationFit.method: Train complete-period allocation likelihood; equal source-family weights

selectionRule: Proceed to registered three-seed Dev comparison only if the best of the same 20 epochs improves source-weighted held-Train mean NLL against the preserved unweighted training selected by that identical source-weighted criterion. Preserve every horizon/censor stratum; no family or example is removed or loss clipped.

trainAudit.scope: Train-only identity and existing source-held loss diagnosis; no Dev/Test scores, fitting or seed selection

defaultCompatibility.scope: Exact CPU default-path comparison with committed sequence.py on a small production training graph; no efficacy claim

decision.reason: The same source-weighted held-Train criterion did not improve. Preserve the tested prototype and raw measurements, remove the unused production option. No new Dev/Test or frozen holdout evaluation.
